defects.M9-DEV-085: Each ResizeObserver callback fitted and sent identical grids, including hundreds of unnecessary raw native resize IPCs during a 5s actual drag. One cancellable visible frame scheduler now measures latest geometry and sends only changed valid positive integer cell dimensions. Hidden/minimized zero-sized hosts cannot fit/send; restored visibility requests a fresh fit. Each PTY owns a fresh scheduler. Original PtyAccess authorization/ownership is unchanged.

basis: P04 requires five actual seconds of dragging, frame coalescing, unchanged-size suppression, correct final geometry and no sustained main-process blocking.

Duplicate size suppression and nonzero dimensions are direct behavioral requirements. Frame count is an aggregate App bound with two boundary messages; exact coalescing is additionally verified with a deterministic scheduler, not inferred from aggregate timing alone.

250ms maximum event-loop lag and 100 samples at 25ms are pre-execution engineering gates for this local fixture, not observed Codex performance or a general all-device SLA. No minimum display refresh rate is invented.
budget.changePolicy: Preserve E1 and failures. Do not loosen a gate to count the current execution as passed.

performance.boundaries: Frozen engineering E1 before first drag; unchanged in red/current runs. Actual 120Hz display, passive RAF/pointer timestamps, additional passive main IPC resize observer and 25ms heartbeat timer. Measurements run solo after build/code tests. No minimum FPS/all-device throughput/cold-cache SLA inferred.

m4DriverCorrection: Legacy probe could inspect pre-reload DOM because Page.reload returned before new document navigation; wait for a different performance.timeOrigin and required target. Preserve first5 technical checks/null-click failure. Add bounded own-child cleanup after failed test, manually stop only original own test executable+observedport51616 to clear hung legacy child. Same packagedApp final7checks green, source runtime unchanged.
driverCorrection: r37 first run passed all frozen performance gates but compared final separator left against initial separator left. Its4px handle was grabbed at centre while production correctly uses actual pointer x as boundary. Correct assertion compares measured final left against requested pointer x with unchanged1.5px tolerance. Pre-correction driver/result/screenshot preserved; no production source or budget change to fix this driver error.
boundaries: A actual packaged renderer/native IPC/PTY and trusted pointer/tree/menu/navigation/stop-resume. Project/profile/task setup uses public IPC. Main inspector only adds own-sender passive resize observer/timer and controls own window size/minimize/restore; it never replaces handlers/authorization/results.

P03 keeps task PTY/id and actual input-only receiver pid stable across hide file, hide task, window minimize/size/restore; raw sizes all positive, hidden task phase sends0. Last original size equals actual kernel PTY rows/columns after restore.

P07 exact same task remains stopped while opening/refreshing/reading external changes. Explicit UI resume creates a new PTY/receiver; ordinary file operations cannot restart it. Missing own root has recoverable UI error while receiver remains running. Restoring directory on disk is cleanup, not native permission/regrant acceptance.

M4 UI probe is existing programmatic DOM-click technical renderer/IPC/PTY fake-runner smoke;7checks do not count new formal cases and do not prove P09 model/real resources/voice/global shortcuts. CLI probe not rerun against denied Codex target.

No prototype UI changes; cases only requireA. Fit helper11tests plus existing terminal-key4/PtyAccess7 validate coalescing, latest size, hidden checks, invalid grids, cancel/late-frame disposal and independent scheduler. Historical1721 is union, not fresh full-suite execution.

Own input-only terminal receives0bytes/executes0commands; unrelatedr4/r6 pending57bytes, daily credentials/resources, system clipboard and AIS directory untouched. All source fixture fingerprints unchanged. No commit/push/merge/tag/release.
